_comment: SystemConfig registry (§1a). DEFAULT / all-off baseline: every system OFF so the canonical world_hash (d950a6afc12a5cdc) and visual baselines stay byte-identical. Spec: .forge/specs/system-config/spec.md. sim.* may change sim state (hashed when enabled); render.* is render-only (never hashed). systems.game.json is the intended-ON profile.

sim._ecology_comment: Creature-brain tuning (spec 011). enabled:false -> the compiled defaults are used (byte-identical). Set enabled:true to apply these values; the shown values ARE the defaults, so flip enabled alone changes nothing until you tweak a number. Levers: energy/sleep cadence, hunger/stamina pacing, herd cohesion (herd_weight/alignment_weight), predator reach (catch_radius/satiation).
